description: This file defines custom error classes for domain-specific errors, along with helper functions to generate JSON responses and register exception handlers within a FastAPI application. It centralizes error management and provides structured error responses.

classes.name: DomainError
classes.description: Base class for domain-specific errors, encapsulating message, code, and details.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Error raised when a resource is not found; subclass of DomainError.

classes.name: ValidationError
classes.description: Error raised on domain validation failure; subclass of DomainError.

classes.name: ConflictError
classes.description: Error raised when there is a conflict with the resource state; subclass of DomainError.

methods.name: JSONResponse _error_response( *, http_status: int, err_type: str, message: str, code: Optional[str] = None, details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None )
methods.description: Constructs a JSONResponse with detailed error payload based on provided parameters.

methods.name: None register_exception_handlers(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Registers FastAPI exception handlers for custom domain errors to return structured JSON error responses.

methods.name: None __init__(self, message: str, *, code: Optional[str] = None, details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, message: str, *, code: Optional[str] = None, details: Optional[Dict[str, /
ctags.signature: (self, message: str, *, code: Optional[str] = None, details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)

ctags.name: _error_response
ctags.signature: ( *, http_status: int, err_type: str, message: str, code: Optional[str] = None, details: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None )

ctags.name: _handle_conflict
ctags.pattern: /^    async def _handle_conflict(_: Request, exc: ConflictError) -> JSONResponse:  # pragma: no co/

ctags.name: _handle_domain
ctags.pattern: /^    async def _handle_domain(_: Request, exc: DomainError) -> JSONResponse:  # pragma: no cover /

ctags.name: _handle_not_found
ctags.pattern: /^    async def _handle_not_found(_: Request, exc: NotFoundError) -> JSONResponse:  # pragma: no c/

ctags.name: _handle_validation
ctags.pattern: /^    async def _handle_validation(_: Request, exc: ValidationError) -> JSONResponse:  # pragma: n/
